items_flat.title_en: Musk highlights Farmersville's plan to draft council minutes with Grok
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克轉發：加州法默斯維爾擬用 Grok 起草市議會紀錄
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI/xAI did not announce a new government product. On Oct 4, Elon Musk quote-posted a report that Farmersville, California, voted 4-1 on Sept 29 to have Grok draft verbatim council minutes from recordings, with the city clerk proofreading. The Sun-Gazette reported interim city manager Kevin Northcraft put the service at $30 a month and called it more affordable and objective than human drafting.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI／xAI 並未宣布新的政府產品。10月4日，伊隆·馬斯克轉發報導：加州法默斯維爾市議會9月29日以4比1通過，由 Grok 依會議錄音起草逐字紀錄，再由市書記校對。當地報紙引述代理市經理 Kevin Northcraft，服務月費30美元，並稱比人工撰寫更省、更客觀。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a small civic workflow trial, not a lab shipment. It shows Grok transcription reaching local government, but a human clerk remains in the loop, so accuracy and public-record liability are still untested.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是小型市政流程試用，不是實驗室新產品。Grok 轉寫已進入地方政府，但仍由書記把關，準確度與公文書責任尚未被驗證。
items_flat.quote: They are also more objective, since they don’t involve a human person having to try to interpret what is appropriate and what is not.
items_flat.quote_zh: 它們也更客觀，因為不需要由人去判斷什麼該記、什麼不該記。

brief_en: Quiet 12 hours: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and xAI posted no new official launches. The only verified lab-linked item is Elon Musk amplifying a small California city's vote to draft council minutes with Grok, still clerk-reviewed.
brief_zh: 近12小時各大廠無新官方發布。僅馬斯克轉發加州小鎮用Grok起草議事錄，仍由書記校對。
